Is US$499 a deposit or rental fee?

It is the listed equipment rental fee. A rental period and any deposit or return conditions have not yet been specified and must be confirmed before purchase.

What does the discount apply to?

The checkout preview applies a demo code to the US$1,999 subscription only. Equipment rental is excluded. Real partner offers will follow the final commercial rules.

Can I complete payment?

The supplied PayPal button is available in checkout. It uses USD and its merchant-configured amount, not the local reference subtotal or demo discount. Payment confirmation and subscription activation require separate processing.
